_about: Carlo Gavazzi EM340 over Modbus TCP (RS485-to-TCP converter). Addresses, scale factors and word order from the manufacturer's EM340 communication protocol (v2 rev17, July 2021): values are INTEGERS with a scale factor, NOT IEEE floats; 32-bit values put the LEAST significant word first (device.word_order 'little'); the manual states that function codes 03 and 04 are interchangeable on this meter. Voltage is Volt*10, current Ampere*1000, power Watt*10 (declared here in kW: scale 0.1*0.001), power factor *1000 (INT16, one register), frequency Hz*10 (INT16), energy kWh*10. Set device.host / unit_id for your installation. A position holds at most 8 variables (the billing policy): this map is exactly 8.
